units.source_text: 我姑且不提比拟孩子的抚子花，

en.t: For now, I will set aside the pinks that were compared to the child,

units.source_text: 却想起古歌‘夫妇之床不积尘’之句，不免怀念夫妇之情，

en.t: but I remembered the old poem saying that no dust gathers on a husband and wife's bed, and could not help longing for the bond between husband and wife,

units.source_text: 就用常夏花来比拟这做母亲的人，给她安慰。

en.t: so I compared this mother to the everlasting summer flower and comforted her.
The woman then recited another poem:
